notes.title: "Status" Update!
notes.content:
Thanks so much for everyone who checked out the demo and provided helpful feedback! It's been a few weeks and I wanted to get some much needed bug fixes and updates into your hands.

If you aren't a part of our Discord yet, please join below to give feedback, tell me about bugs, and most importantly to find friends to play against! This really helps me improve the demo, and subsequently, the game.

Fantasy Football Tactics Discord!


Demo Build (v0.5.3) is Live! 
Here's what changed...

Gameplay/Content

Status effects now display in unit HUD and unit overview UI, including turn count that tells you how long the status will be active.

Scoring team now passes ball to opponent after a score, similar to kickoffs in football.

Rain Jay music has been reverted to its original playtest track.

Modified offense CPU behavior for first main quest.

Bugs fixed in this build:

Units can no longer learn locked abilities.

BP bar no longer gets stuck on a wallop color in the unit overview.

Controller/keyboard can now be used to scroll stats and prediction screens.

Camera now always pans to unit when earning experience points.

Camera no longer pans too quickly after an action when screen shake is disabled.

You can now select tiles behind walloped units more easily.

Please take this update for a spin and let me know what you think! You can check it out here:

Fantasy Football Tactics Demo

notes.title: Demo Launch: Play Fantasy Football Tactics Today!
notes.content:
Shiny Happy Demo Updates![p align="start"]Thanks so much to everyone who helped check out the playtest and provided so much great feedback. It really helped me improve the game.


[p align="start"]I am thrilled to share that the demo is out now for everyone to enjoy! Even if you've played the game before I hope you'll check it out and continue to provide feedback so I can make the full launch even better.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186069/5579ec4bbeceeb2422e9810dc7e408a949752186.png"]Queen Versephone in all her glory!


[p align="start"]The demo contains a veritable starting lineup of new content and changes. A few highlights include:

Meet Queen Versephone on the new Castle playfield. Be warned, she’s a fierce competitor!

Extensive bug fixes and difficulty tuning.

Vertical range and area of effect restrictions. Now you can really use height to your advantage!

Improved graphics, art and lighting effects. They have shiny metal helmets now!

New soundtrack instrumentation (Alternative Chip Tune Rock! 🤘🏻👾)

Improved UX, including name tags and clearer turn order display

Four new abilities to experiment with including:

Handoff - Give ball to adjacent ally and their turn is guaranteed to be next.

Revive - Bring back a Walloped ally immediately with full health.

Tush Push - Push an ally, and anyone behind them, up to two tiles.

Strip - Attempts to take the ball from an opponent.

Modified abilities:

Stiff Arm - I got a lot of play test feedback on this one and it’s way more fun for it. Stiff Arm can now be used at all times, including ricocheting an opponent off an obstacle or even pushing them off the field entirely!

Bullet - This has been opened up and no longer requires line of sight. In exchange, the range has been pulled in.

View movement and passing range of any unit.

Improved goal animation and sounds!

Plus all of the great stuff built during the play test like settings, controller support and Remote Play Together for versus mode.

And more I’m sure I’m forgetting about!
[p align="start"]I hope you have a blast exploring the new content. Please check out the demo and let me know what you think!



-John

notes.title: Controller Support, Remote Play Together, Discord and More!
notes.content:
Playtest Update! (v0.3.0)
Greetings Fantasy Footballers! I wanted to share some exciting updates for the playtest that are now available in the latest playtest build (v0.3.0) for both Windows and Mac.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45186069/ac27120856b8cf4289ebe55e52be00ac78edc329.png"]

The major highlights include:

Controller Support! (DualSense, Xbox Series and Switch Pro)

Remote Play Together! Play a Quick Match against a friend from anywhere.

Team and Field Selection in Local Multiplayer

Camera Controls (including pan and zoom support)

Enhanced Lighting and Water Effects

Improved UI/UX

Improved Wallop and Super Fumbles

Several bug fixes

...and more!

I really appreciate everyone who has taken the time to play the game and provide feedback. It has really helped solidify my roadmap as I move towards a public demo launch, including most of the changes in this build. So please, keep the feedback coming! I love hearing from players about what they like or think could be improved in FFT.



To access the playtest build in your library, just click the Request Access button on the store page here: 

Fantasy Football Tactics on Steam


Join us on Discord!
I'm happy to announce we have a small but vibrant community on Discord, and we'd love to have you join us! This is a great place to provide feedback on the game or find folks to play Quick Matches against using Remote Play Together. I hope you'll stop on by!

Fantasy Football Tactics Discord



Thanks for reading!

-John
